WITH presence_owner AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT CASE WHEN system.main.td_owner_probe_validated_check() IS NOT TRUE THEN error('TD_E_OWNER_PROBE_INVALID: owner scope is not audited') WHEN NOT (SELECT ok FROM (SELECT CASE
 WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM main.store_meta)<>1 OR EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM main.store_meta WHERE version IS NULL OR version NOT IN(5,6,8,9,10,11))
 THEN error('TD_E_COMMAND_FORMAT: unsupported native store format')
 WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM td_catalog_v1.catalog_revision)>1 OR EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM td_catalog_v1.catalog_revision WHERE singleton IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE OR revision IS NULL OR revision NOT IN(2,3))
 THEN error('TD_E_COMMAND_FORMAT: unsupported native catalog revision')
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM main.store_meta m WHERE CASE m.version
   WHEN 5 THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM td_catalog_v1.catalog_revision WHERE revision<>2)
   WHEN 9 THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM td_catalog_v1.catalog_revision)<>1
   WHEN 10 THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM td_catalog_v1.catalog_revision)<>1
   WHEN 11 THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM td_catalog_v1.catalog_revision)<>1
   ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM td_catalog_v1.catalog_revision WHERE revision=2)<>1 END)
 THEN error('TD_E_COMMAND_FORMAT: native format/catalog revision mismatch')
 ELSE TRUE END ok) native_format) THEN error('TD_E_COMMAND_FORMAT: unsupported native catalog') WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM system.main.pragma_database_list)<>1 THEN error('TD_E_QUERY_CATALOG: visible extra attachments are unsupported') WHEN system.main.td_float_from_bits_v1('0000000000000000')<>0 THEN error('TD_E_QUERY_PROFILE: invalid float codec') ELSE TRUE END ok), presence_cut AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT position FROM main.clock WHERE singleton)>='18'::BIGINT THEN TRUE ELSE error('TD_E_COMMAND_INTERVAL: knowledge cut exceeds transaction-visible clock') END ok FROM presence_owner WHERE ok), presence_targets(entity_id) AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES ('reset'::VARCHAR)), presence_scoped AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT e.entity_id,n.position,e.operation,e.valid_from lo,e.valid_to hi FROM td_catalog_v1.entity_presence_edits e JOIN presence_targets t ON t.entity_id=e.entity_id JOIN td_catalog_v1.entity_commands n ON n.command_id=e.command_id AND n.entity_id=e.entity_id CROSS JOIN presence_cut g WHERE g.ok AND n.position<='18'::BIGINT UNION ALL SELECT m.entity_id,c.position,m.operation,m.valid_from lo,m.valid_to hi FROM td_catalog_v1.entity_batch_members m JOIN presence_targets t ON t.entity_id=m.entity_id JOIN td_catalog_v1.entity_batches b USING(command_id) JOIN main.commands c USING(command_id) JOIN td_catalog_v1.schema_type_modes modes ON modes.schema_name=b.schema_name AND modes.entity_type=m.entity_type CROSS JOIN presence_cut g WHERE g.ok AND modes.is_live AND c.position<='18'::BIGINT LIMIT 5), presence_admission AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM presence_scoped)>4 THEN error('TD_E_PRESENCE_LIMIT: scoped presence event limit exceeded') ELSE TRUE END ok FROM presence_cut WHERE ok), presence_events AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT e.* FROM presence_scoped e CROSS JOIN presence_admission g WHERE g.ok)
, presence_last_put AS (
 SELECT entity_id,max(position) FILTER(WHERE operation='put') last_put
 FROM presence_events GROUP BY entity_id
), presence_eligible AS (
 SELECT e.entity_id,e.position,e.lo,e.hi
 FROM presence_events e JOIN presence_last_put p USING(entity_id)
 WHERE (e.operation='put' AND e.position=p.last_put)
    OR (e.operation='patch' AND (p.last_put IS NULL OR e.position>p.last_put))
), presence_ordered AS (
 SELECT *,max(hi) OVER(PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY lo,hi,position
   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) prior_hi
 FROM presence_eligible
), presence_marked AS (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN prior_hi IS NULL OR lo>prior_hi THEN 1 ELSE 0 END starts
 FROM presence_ordered
), presence_grouped AS (
 SELECT *,sum(starts) OVER(PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY lo,hi,position
   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) island
 FROM presence_marked
), presence_islands AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT entity_id,min(lo) lo,max(hi) hi
 FROM presence_grouped GROUP BY entity_id,island
)
, presence_rows AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t.entity_id,'18'::BIGINT known_at, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM presence_events e WHERE e.entity_id=t.entity_id) has_edit_at_cut, i.lo valid_from,i.hi valid_to FROM presence_targets t LEFT JOIN presence_islands i USING(entity_id)), presence_result_guard AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(valid_from) FROM presence_rows)>8 THEN error('TD_E_PRESENCE_LIMIT: presence interval limit exceeded') WHEN (SELECT coalesce(sum(octet_length(encode(entity_id))::BIGINT+9+CASE WHEN valid_from IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 16 END),0) FROM presence_rows)>1048576 THEN error('TD_E_PRESENCE_LIMIT: presence result byte limit exceeded') ELSE TRUE END ok FROM presence_admission WHERE ok) SELECT r.entity_id,r.known_at,r.has_edit_at_cut,r.valid_from,r.valid_to FROM presence_result_guard g CROSS JOIN presence_rows r WHERE g.ok ORDER BY r.entity_id,r.valid_from,r.valid_to
